Body.Content:
You can now download an existing Azure dashboard in the same JSON format that you can use to programmatically create dashboards by calling Azure Resource Manager APIs. Previously, you had to use a separate tool like Azure Resource Explorer to get this data.

You can also upload a dashboard file in the same format, to import a dashboard created by you or someone who has shared it with you.

Both of these capabilities are available directly on the dashboard via one click:
